title: Reduce repeated ILE reads and JIT loads in average cost adjustment
summary: Codeunit 5895 Inventory Adjustment reduces repeated database reads and JIT loads during average cost calculation by caching Item Ledger Entry data, loading required fields upfront, and removing ineffective LoadFields calls.
key_points: Caches the immutable Positive field from Item Ledger Entry in a dictionary to eliminate repeated lookups
Loads all required chain fields upfront in ExcludeAvgCostOnValuationDate and IsAvgCostException to prevent JIT loads
Removes ineffective LoadFields calls in AvgValueEntriesToAdjustExist and CollectOpenValueEntries
Adds missing fields to load lists: Applied Entry to Adjust and Valuation Date
Improves performance for high-volume items where processing time grew quadratically with value entries
